svg.title: Offline quantization memory and serving memory answer different sizing questions
svg.desc: An offline quantization job can process one transformer layer at a time, so peak GPU memory tracks the largest layer plus calibration buffers. A serving endpoint must keep every quantized layer resident together with the KV cache, runtime activations, and engine overhead — and the KV cache is the term that grows with context length and batch size.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Quantizing a model can be layer-bounded. Serving needs the whole checkpoint resident.
